output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast Dec 19

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage. Getting our christmas breakfast together again and wanted to see if we can get the back room Saturday Dec 19 at 7am, same as always. If the 19th is no good could you do the 12th instead? We'd rather have the 19th if its open because Earl's last day driving is the 18th so it would be the morning after he gets done.

Dwayne got me the list off the board and right now its 24 counting Earl and his wife Carol. Thats 19 drivers, 3 from the shop and those two. I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you wanted last year so you know how much food to fix. Just let me know if 24 is alright for that room. Separate checks again please, that worked good before.

Can we do the same food as last year, the big pans of eggs and home fries and biscuits and gravy, then everybody orders there own meat off the menu? The $11 a head was fair and if its gone up a little thats fine, just let me know what it is now so I can tell everybody ahead of time. Is coffee still included with that?

Couple things on the food and getting in. Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes instead, or whatever you've got thats easy enough to do separate from the pans? Let me know what would work for her and if thats a different price. Also Lonnie is on a walker since his hip and can't do the steps. Can we have him come in that side door with no steps, and will it be unlocked at 7? If he needs to come a little different way to get back to our room just tell me and I'll make sure he knows.

We're wanting to do a little something for Earl retiring, but he can't find out beforehand so please keep that part quiet. He's drove 31 years and we don't want to let him get away without something. Carol said he'd be embarrassed by a big speech so nothing too big, just us having breakfast and a little treat for him.

Would it be alright if we brought a cake from Sugarcreek, or could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle? Your rolls are better than any cake anyhow and Earl loves them. I checked with Sugarcreek and they need 5 days notice, so wanted to ask you before I order anything. Let me know what a tray big enough for everybody would run. I think he'd be real happy with those.

One other thing, you mentioned having a backup for the coffee after that urn quit last year. Would you still be able to have an extra pot ready just in case? I know you felt bad about it and things break, wasn't anybody's fault. Just figured I'd ask while we're getting everything set up, we do go through plenty of coffee.

Thanks Rhonda, we always look forward to coming over there. Let me know on the date and the rest when you get a chance.

Gary
